title: World's Longest Metro? Not Tokyo or New York — Shanghai | China Travel Expert
description:
Ask people which city has the world's biggest metro and you'll hear Tokyo, London or New York. By route length it's none of them — it's Shanghai.

The Shanghai municipal government put the network at 898 km of total operating mileage in December 2025, with the second phase of Line 18 set to push it past 900 km. More than 500 stations serve it, and it is still being extended.

For a traveller that means almost everything you want to see is on a metro line, signage is bilingual, and a single ride across the city costs a few yuan.

🧭 Expert Tip: use the metro for airport-to-city hops at rush hour — it beats a taxi on the elevated roads every time.

上海地铁按运营里程是世界最长：2025年12月官方数字898公里，18号线二期通车后将超过900公里，车站500多座，而且还在延伸。
